objective: Decide, per host and per task, whether delegating one finding verification or one failure classification to the repository's read-only subagent improves the verdict enough to justify its latency and usage, compared with the inline fallback that every host must keep.

tasks.source_of_truth: the matching debugger SKILL.md F1-F15 table (absolute path passed by the caller)

out_of_scope.generator_v6_fresh_context_review: independence requirement, not a cost optimization; never weakened by this benchmark

evaluated_snapshot.policy: Digests below are recorded at preparation time from git HEAD c5e331b88d5b6488aea3adbe873d529c02a44a79 (tag v1.16.0). One immutable digest over all of these surfaces plus fixtures, oracle, prompts, runner, rubric, and schedule is recorded in freeze-record.json at freeze; any later drift makes the run INCONCLUSIVE.

preconditions: output-discipline v2 replay and fresh pilot reached a terminal, integrity-checked result (recorded in .handover/artifacts/handover-20260903-144354-c12d46/evidence/); reconfirm at freeze that no newer output-discipline run is in flight
fresh `/bin/bash -p scripts/ci/ci-local.sh` and `/bin/bash -p scripts/ci/pre-push-security.sh` green on the evaluated tree
one immutable digest over the evaluated skill, both Claude agent Markdown files, both Codex TOML ports, the inline fallback text, fixtures, oracle, prompts, runner, rubric, and schedule
declared maximum strategy executions, actual-request ceiling, wall-time budget, and stop rule (all present below)
provider limits available without interrupting another benchmark; not started immediately after another large model pilot
the five feasibility smoke cases (amendment c) pass for every ACTIVE arm before the runner is frozen

protocol_amendments_incorporated.a_parent_child_request_accounting: Every cell logs actual model requests, tokens, elapsed time, and visible cost separately for the parent session and for each child session. The legacy phrase '240 model calls' is retired: 240 is the full-matrix count of strategy executions, not requests. Unknown child telemetry is recorded as null, never estimated or conflated with parent usage.
protocol_amendments_incorporated.b_codex_native_role_attestation: A Codex native-role arm whose harness cannot prove which role actually ran (or cannot force the named-versus-native distinction) records UNAVAILABLE for that cell. Silent substitution of another route is a protocol violation that voids the arm.
protocol_amendments_incorporated.c_feasibility_smoke_gate: The five smoke cases (one per host arm: claude.inline, claude.named, codex.inline, codex.named, codex.native-role) must pass before the runner is frozen. For the Claude-only phase the two Claude smoke cases must pass; the three Codex smoke cases run when that arm is activated. Any runner change after the smoke invalidates it and requires a new protocol version.
protocol_amendments_incorporated.d_freshness_search_recorded: The search used to establish the 16 fresh cases is recorded in freshness_exclusion_search below and rerun at freeze.

freshness_exclusion_search.freshness_definition: development-level independence: no source-byte duplicate and no scenario/defect-lineage duplicate of any case in the existing corpora, evals, holdouts, output-discipline pilot corpora, or examples in skill prose. Pattern IDs and F-codes are a closed vocabulary of 24 and 15 entries respectively and are NOT the freshness unit; the scenario, application domain, selectors, test names, file layout, and defect lineage are.

Judged fields for this phase are reported as unjudged, never self-judged by the same Claude identity under test. Opposite-provider judging is deferred until a Codex arm is separately authorized.

metrics_per_host_task_stratum: parent and child requests, tokens, and cost separately (null when unobservable)

decision.unit: one outcome per host per task

rules.ALWAYS_DELEGATE: the named route is majority-stable on both clear and context-dependent strata, introduces no additional harmful fix, and its correctness benefit over inline is stable and not confined to one case (at least two independent decisive cases in each stratum)
rules.SELECTIVE_DELEGATE: the named route improves context-dependent (or two-codes / f1_vs_f7) cases without a stable advantage on clear cases; route only the documented ambiguity classes; clear cases stay inline
rules.INLINE_DEFAULT: delegation shows no stable correctness/calibration benefit, regresses any case, or adds material latency/usage without compensating quality
rules.INCONCLUSIVE: missing arm, unstable repetitions, integrity failure, ceiling exceeded without authorization, or fewer independent decisive cases than the rule requires

stop_rules: actual-request hard ceiling reached without operator authorization
missing cell, duplicate session, digest drift, role mismatch, tool leakage, workspace mutation, parse failure, incomplete cleanup
any child process surviving its parent's timeout

ceiling_behavior.confirmation_checkpoint: PAUSE_AND_ASK at 2x naive actual requests or 2x naive wall time
ceiling_behavior.hard_ceiling: PAUSE_AND_ASK; declining ends the run INCOMPLETE with partial raw evidence preserved and unscored; authorizing continuation labels the report CEILING_EXCEEDED_WITH_AUTHORIZATION, which makes ALWAYS_DELEGATE unreachable for that host (a routing change that needed over-budget evidence is not a stable benefit) while SELECTIVE_DELEGATE, INLINE_DEFAULT, and INCONCLUSIVE remain reachable

allowed_if_result_supports_and_user_asks: smallest wording change to the delegation blocks only: skills/e2e-reviewer/SKILL.md (Verifying findings), skills/playwright-debugger/SKILL.md and skills/cypress-debugger/SKILL.md (Classifier delegation)
agent descriptions only if their trigger/routing promise changed
targeted tests, full local CI, pre-push security
confirmation on a separately frozen fresh case set before treating the routing decision as stable
never: remove or weaken the inline fallback
SP1-SP5 subagent parity contracts in scripts/ci/review.sh

required_artifacts: this protocol and its SHA-256, plus codex-arm-activation.json and its SHA-256 when present
freeze-record.json: fixture/oracle/rubric/schedule digests, evaluated agent/skill/runner snapshot digest, freshness recheck output, model identity
raw parent and child outputs per cell
exact strategy-execution, judge-call, and actual-request counts (parent and child separately)
latency and observable usage report with null for unobservable telemetry
limitations and the selected routing outcome per host per task
explicit statement that production routing was not changed by the measured run
limitations: Sixteen cases support a directional routing pilot, not a generalized performance claim; any production change needs a separate confirmation set.
Host CLIs may not expose reliable child model identity or child token usage; the benchmark is an end-to-end routing comparison and reports unavailable telemetry as null.
With the Codex arm dormant, opposite-provider blind judging has no provider; judged fields are reported as unjudged unless a Codex judge budget is separately authorized.
The naive request estimate is an assumption; the ceiling is a multiple of that assumption.
